review.body:
Independent re-review of successor 87458855174643c9ef29a25c9d4def16d81880b6.

The owner-equivalence finding from review5507108723 is cleared at this source head, subject to all required hosted checks passing on it. The only changes since reviewed 4a20cc59 are the privilege query and its native PostgreSQL regression. pg_has_role(...,'MEMBER') conservatively rejects direct and indirect owner membership regardless of INHERIT/SET options, covering the identified escalation.

I independently evaluated the exact fetched successor SQL and assertion on an isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 catalog fixture containing all 170 signatures. The ordinary limited role passed all 170 facts; direct NOINHERIT/SET-enabled owner membership was refused; the same membership through a bridge role was refused; removing membership admitted the limited role again. Immediate EXECUTE still matched the 23/147 partition in every case, so the refusal comes from the corrected owner check. The owned disposable container was stopped and removed. The new product test additionally demonstrates SET ROLE reaching the formerly denied broad closure before revoking the membership.

Migration 0265, its readiness pins and the proposed 23-statement grant block are unchanged from the prior source review. The block's trimmed UTF-8 SHA256 remains 474d70e56baef8874150f509c40207957affc10682934270c49e9d784604f814. No new source blocker found in this successor.

Hosted CI is still running on this exact head; 4a20cc59's green result does not substitute for it. Merge through the protected API squash path only after exact-head checks complete. Actual staging grants still need explicit approval of the unchanged reviewed block and a fresh binding of the serving URL/principal to effective staging Hyperdrive. Source clearance is not a grant/deploy or phone receipt. The separate Solid G3 privacy regression remains open.
